summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a 6-K announcing the divestiture of its Talicia business to Apotex Health Corp. RedHill sold its 70% stake in Talicia Holdings Inc. to Apotex for $18 million upfront plus up to $35 million in net sales milestones, with Apotex already holding the other 30%. The deal includes a five-year non-compete on the product in the U.S. and a six-month transition services agreement, extendable three months. No premium, advisors, or closing date were specified; proceeds fund strategic growth. Watch for milestone achievement and RedHill's repositioning impact.
